text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, revere me to your heart's 
content! With words truly befitting a 
victor!
choice_data_list: As expected of a first-class girl!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, looking good! Keep it up♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Praising me just once isn't enough♪ Come 
on, one more time! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Splendid, I feel absolute best!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since we're already at it, why not 
say it one more time? Come on, we still 
have plenty of time, right? Please? Pretty 
please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up showering King Halo 
with praise until she was completely 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, then could you prepare a 
race that is even more befitting of a 
King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—"You're convinced I'm cut out for much 
bigger things than a race like this, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll save my compliments for the winner 
until then. Ohohoho!
